component.name: U4025QW Test Firmware
component.summary: Synthetic test cab for the dell-monitor-rt plugin's emulation-mode bring-up

description.p: Wraps the M3T105 .upg in a cab so fwupdtool emulation-load can drive the plugin's write_firmware path against a recorded device fixture. Not for real installs — version is bumped past what real hardware reports so the install step actually triggers.
Synthetic version bump (real bundle is M3T105) so the install path triggers under emulation.
